object_description: elongated three-story building with a longitudinal volume
design_condition: The elongated volume follows the existing development structure between the neighboring school buildings, maintaining distance from the kindergarten and organizing upper and lower outdoor spaces along the slope.

positive.statement: The simple and clear urban planning setting precisely follows the logic of the existing buildings.
The building acts as a mediator between the neighboring educational buildings.
Its distance from the kindergarten enables a good connection to the outdoor sports fields.
The building arrangement provides good lighting for the ground-floor rooms.
The architectural language has been developed appropriately and site-specifically.
The transparent partitions enable pleasant and clear room sequences.
The meandering corridor creates pleasantly zoned spatial sequences.
The exercise rooms are easy to fold and use.

negative.statement: The entrance zones and the outdoor areas close to the building are not yet convincing.
A more feasible and usable solution for addressing the topography is required.
The garden-like upper open space does not seem robust enough for intensive play.
The southern tip of the area can only be used to a limited extent.
The transparent partitions leave the desired intimacy somewhat lacking.
The wardrobes have limited dimensions and functionality.
The office space is somewhat too small.
The longitudinal construction creates disadvantageously long corridor situations.
The project is classified as rather expensive.
